# Amherstburg Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Amherstburg. Heat pump service covers diagnosis and repair of heating or cooling faults and installation planning for replacement equipment, including controls, electrical components, refrigerant circuits, and defrost functions.

Email: contact@amherstburgheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://amherstburgheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Amherstburg, Windsor, LaSalle, Tecumseh, Leamington, Lakeshore, Belle River, Essex. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
